15.1 Glossary of Terms

TermExplanation
TemplatePredefined document framework with blocks and variables
BlockIndividual content element of a document (section, table, logo, etc.)
VariablePlaceholder in the text, e.g. {an_firma}, which is replaced by actual values
ScopeCategory of a template: contract, invoice, general
DOCXMicrosoft Word file format (.docx)
PDFPortable Document Format — platform-independent document format
ReferenceUnique identifier for a generated document, e.g. ANF-2026-0042
Framework AgreementBasic agreement between abcona e.K. and a contractor
Sub-Service AgreementIndividual order based on an existing framework agreement
FixturePredefined database entries from JSON files — imported during the init command
AssemblerInternal component that combines blocks and variables into a finished document
StyleKitCollection of formatting definitions (fonts, colors, spacing)
PageLayoutPage configuration with margins, size, and header/footer spacing
